assembly_instructions: Conceptual presentation model, 1x scale, meters, +X forward / +Y up / +Z port, right-handed. Build order: (1) cast the concrete base_pad as the structural root. (2) Set the vault wall on it: floor_sill first, then the two end posts and the mid divider; bolt the three stacked back panels in sequence (back_panel_lower, then press back_seam_1 into its top joint, back_panel_mid, then press back_seam_2 into its top joint, back_panel_upper) so each seam plate caps a panel joint; cap the stack with the top_lintel; press six vault_bolt heads in a row across the upper panel band; bolt the two header label plates onto the lintel front face. (3) Seat the 3x2 grid of brass legacy lock cylinders in the starboard bay, press a brass escutcheon ring onto each face, and insert the withdrawn brass key (blade + bow) into lock 6. (4) Seat the 2x2 grid of dark-anodized PQC lock modules in the port bay, fit each with a glass lattice indicator panel, and recess an ML-KEM keyway slot into each panel. (5) Bolt the two gantry foot baseplates to the pad, stand the welded-steel gantry legs on them, span the legs with the conveyor beam, weld a diagonal knee-brace at each leg-to-beam joint, and mount the brass migration_arrow on the beam pointing toward the PQC bay; ride the carriage on the beam on two trolley wheels, bolt the migration gripper under it, and clamp the in-transit dark-anodized key module (with its glass transit panel) into the gripper. (6) Stand the brushed-steel distribution hub on the pad, cap it with the status dome and beacon sphere, then run five copper links out to the five white-composite door nodes. The whole mechanism is left open — no covers — so every lock and the conveyor read at a glance.

info.japanese_name: 耐量子鍵移行ボールト
info.summary: An illustrative cryptographic vault showing the migration of legacy RSA/ECC keys to larger lattice-based post-quantum keys. It dramatizes the operational task of re-keying every node in a public-key infrastructure before quantum attacks become viable.
info.description: The vault wall holds two bays. The starboard bay stores legacy asymmetric keys as small brass lock cylinders — RSA-3072 public keys are only 384 bytes and ECDSA P-256 signatures 64 bytes, so the cylinders are compact. The port bay stores lattice-based post-quantum modules as bulky boxes: an ML-KEM-768 public key is 1,184 bytes and an ML-DSA-65 signature 3,309 bytes, several to tens of times larger, which is conveyed by the noticeably larger module geometry. A gantry conveyor carries one key module from the legacy bay across to the PQC bay, representing the re-issuance step. A central key-distribution hub fans links out to door-node modules — banks, hospitals and network endpoints — that must each receive new certificates. The model follows NIST's standardized algorithms (FIPS 203/204/205, finalized August 2024) and the recommended migration horizon.
info.operator: Conceptual — enterprise PKI and certificate authorities

parts.name: Concrete Floor Pad
parts.role: Ground slab that the vault wall, gantry feet, distribution hub and all door nodes stand on; structural root of the graph.

parts.name: Wall Floor Sill
parts.role: Lower horizontal frame member carrying the weight of the vault wall down to the pad.

parts.name: Vault Wall Back Panel (Lower)
parts.role: Lowest of three stacked back-wall panels; carries the lower row of legacy lock cylinders and bolts to the floor sill below.

parts.name: Wall Panel Seam Plate (Lower/Mid)
parts.role: Brushed-steel recessed seam plate covering the joint between the lower and middle back panels, making the three-panel framed skeleton read as distinct members.

parts.name: Vault Wall Back Panel (Middle)
parts.role: Middle stacked back-wall panel separated from its neighbours by seam plates; carries the lower row of PQC lock modules.

parts.name: Wall Panel Seam Plate (Mid/Upper)
parts.role: Brushed-steel recessed seam plate covering the joint between the middle and upper back panels, marking the panel segmentation in the ISO view.

parts.name: Vault Wall Back Panel (Upper)
parts.role: Top stacked back-wall panel; carries the upper rows of legacy cylinders and PQC modules, the vault-bolt band and the top lintel.

parts.name: Wall Top Lintel
parts.role: Upper horizontal frame member tying the two end posts and mid divider together.

parts.name: Port End Post
parts.role: Vertical end post bounding the post-quantum bay of the vault wall.

parts.name: Starboard End Post
parts.role: Vertical end post bounding the legacy-key bay of the vault wall.

parts.name: Bay Divider Post
parts.role: Central vertical post separating the legacy-key bay from the post-quantum bay.

parts.name: Header Label Plate (Legacy Bay)
parts.role: Engraved 'LEGACY RSA/ECC' name plate bolted to the lintel front above the starboard bay, marking it as the pre-quantum key store.

parts.name: Header Label Plate (PQC Bay)
parts.role: Illuminated 'LATTICE PQC' name plate on the lintel front above the port bay, marking it as the post-quantum key store.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 1
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head on the upper wall band, the iconic vault hardware that fills the steel above the lock grids.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 2
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head on the upper wall band of the legacy bay.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 3
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head on the upper wall band near the bay divider.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 4
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head on the upper wall band of the PQC bay.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 5
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head on the upper wall band of the PQC bay.

parts.name: Vault Locking Bolt Head 6
parts.role: Protruding forged-steel locking-bolt head at the port end of the upper wall band.

parts.name: Legacy RSA/ECC Lock Cylinder 1
parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair; compact because legacy keys are only hundreds of bytes.

parts.name: Legacy RSA/ECC Lock Cylinder 2
parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair.

parts.name: Legacy RSA/ECC Lock Cylinder 3
parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair.

parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair.

parts.name: Legacy RSA/ECC Lock Cylinder 5
parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair.

parts.name: Legacy RSA/ECC Lock Cylinder 6
parts.role: Small old-style key cylinder storing one legacy RSA/ECC keypair; the next slot scheduled for migration, shown with its physical key withdrawn.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 1
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 1, the iconic detail that makes the cylinder read as a physical lock.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 2
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 2.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 3
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 3.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 4
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 4.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 5
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 5.

parts.name: Lock Escutcheon Ring 6
parts.role: Brass keyway escutcheon ring on the face of legacy lock 6, the slot next in line for re-keying.

parts.name: Withdrawn Legacy Key Blade
parts.role: Physical legacy key blade withdrawn from lock 6 for re-keying — proves the cylinders are working locks and dramatizes a key being pulled for migration.

parts.name: Withdrawn Legacy Key Bow
parts.role: Bow (grip ring) at the outer end of the withdrawn legacy key, the part a hand turns to open the cylinder.

parts.name: Lattice PQC Lock Module 1
parts.role: Bulky post-quantum lock module holding an ML-KEM lattice keypair; large to convey the multi-kilobyte key size.

parts.name: Lattice PQC Lock Module 2
parts.role: Bulky post-quantum lock module holding an ML-KEM lattice keypair.

parts.name: Lattice PQC Lock Module 3
parts.role: Bulky post-quantum lock module holding an ML-KEM lattice keypair.

parts.name: Lattice PQC Lock Module 4
parts.role: Bulky post-quantum lock module holding an ML-KEM lattice keypair; empty slot awaiting the module now in transit.

parts.name: PQC Lattice Indicator Panel 1
parts.role: Front-face glass status panel on PQC module 1, lit to show the lattice keypair is loaded and active.

parts.name: PQC Lattice Indicator Panel 2
parts.role: Front-face glass status panel on PQC module 2 showing an active lattice keypair.

parts.name: PQC Lattice Indicator Panel 3
parts.role: Front-face glass status panel on PQC module 3 showing an active lattice keypair.

parts.name: PQC Lattice Indicator Panel 4
parts.role: Front-face glass status panel on PQC module 4, dark because the slot still awaits the module now in transit.

parts.name: ML-KEM Keyway Slot 1
parts.role: Recessed ML-KEM keyway slot on PQC module 1 — the lattice-key insertion interface that distinguishes the module as a functional lock.

parts.name: ML-KEM Keyway Slot 2
parts.role: Recessed ML-KEM keyway slot on PQC module 2, the lattice-key insertion interface.

parts.name: ML-KEM Keyway Slot 3
parts.role: Recessed ML-KEM keyway slot on PQC module 3, the lattice-key insertion interface.

parts.name: ML-KEM Keyway Slot 4
parts.role: Recessed ML-KEM keyway slot on PQC module 4, the lattice-key insertion interface for the module now in transit.

parts.name: Gantry Foot Baseplate (Legacy Side)
parts.role: Bolted-down circular baseplate that anchors the legacy-side gantry leg to the concrete pad and spreads its load.

parts.name: Gantry Foot Baseplate (PQC Side)
parts.role: Bolted-down circular baseplate that anchors the PQC-side gantry leg to the concrete pad and spreads its load.

parts.name: Gantry Leg (Legacy Side)
parts.role: Vertical support leg of the migration gantry on the legacy-bay end.

parts.name: Gantry Leg (PQC Side)
parts.role: Vertical support leg of the migration gantry on the post-quantum-bay end.

parts.name: Gantry Knee-Brace (Legacy Side)
parts.role: Diagonal welded-steel brace stiffening the joint where the legacy-side leg meets the conveyor beam, carrying lateral load into the leg.

parts.name: Gantry Knee-Brace (PQC Side)
parts.role: Diagonal welded-steel brace stiffening the joint where the PQC-side leg meets the conveyor beam.

parts.name: Migration Conveyor Beam
parts.role: Horizontal rail spanning both bays along which the migration carriage travels.

parts.name: Migration Direction Arrow
parts.role: Brass directional arrowhead mounted on the conveyor beam, pointing from the legacy bay toward the PQC bay to mark the legacy->PQC re-keying travel direction.

parts.name: Migration Carriage
parts.role: Trolley riding the gantry beam that grips and transports a key module from the legacy bay to the PQC bay.

parts.name: Carriage Trolley Wheel (Forward)
parts.role: Forward grooved trolley wheel that straddles the conveyor beam and lets the carriage roll toward the legacy bay.

parts.name: Carriage Trolley Wheel (Aft)
parts.role: Aft grooved trolley wheel that straddles the conveyor beam and lets the carriage roll toward the PQC bay.

parts.name: Migration Gripper
parts.role: Clamp head bolted under the carriage that grips the in-transit key module and lowers it into its new PQC slot.

parts.name: Key Module In Transit
parts.role: A PQC key module being re-issued mid-migration, clamped by the gripper above the bay divider — sized to match the destination PQC modules so the legacy-to-PQC re-keying step reads at a glance.

parts.name: In-Transit Module Indicator Panel
parts.role: Glass status panel on the in-transit module, blinking to mark it as the key currently being migrated between bays.

parts.name: Key-Distribution Hub
parts.role: Central hub that pushes freshly migrated keys out over distribution links to every connected endpoint node.

parts.name: Hub Status Dome
parts.role: Tapered glass cap on the distribution hub indicating migration status.

parts.name: Hub Status Beacon
parts.role: Glowing beacon sphere atop the hub dome that signals when a re-keying batch is being distributed to the endpoint nodes.

parts.name: Distribution Link to Bank Node
parts.role: Conduit carrying re-keyed certificates from the hub to the bank door node.

parts.name: Distribution Link to Hospital Node
parts.role: Conduit carrying re-keyed certificates from the hub to the hospital door node.

parts.name: Distribution Link to Node 3
parts.role: Conduit carrying re-keyed certificates from the hub to network node 3.

parts.name: Distribution Link to Node 4
parts.role: Conduit carrying re-keyed certificates from the hub to network node 4.

parts.name: Distribution Link to Node 5
parts.role: Conduit carrying re-keyed certificates from the hub to network node 5.

parts.name: Bank Door Node
parts.role: Endpoint door module representing a bank that must accept post-quantum keys.

parts.name: Hospital Door Node
parts.role: Endpoint door module representing a hospital that must accept post-quantum keys.

parts.name: Network Door Node 3
parts.role: Endpoint door module representing a network node that must accept post-quantum keys.

parts.role: Endpoint door module representing a network node that must accept post-quantum keys.
